description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and configuration functions for certain hardware boards in the OpenWrt build system, including image checks, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying based on board names.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the given image is compatible with the current platform based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process tailored to the specific board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the hardware configuration depending on the board type.
